headline: Board to review trust fund balances, disbursements, and updates on the Powers, Clough, and Fernald Funds.
summary: The board will review fund balances, including the Huntress Fund, and discuss disbursements for funds authorized in January 2026 or earlier. It will also cover updates on the Powers and Clough Funds, a report on the Fernald Fund, and plans for future fund strategy and meetings.
items: Review of current balances from Funds and explanation of Huntress Fund size and location: Linda Pata
